payload.text: (2026-10-21) **MOLT_CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is the switch.** Everything ST0006 WP01 adds runs only on a sleeve whose vars.sh declares it, so merging changes no sleeve and hv arms the move one sleeve at a time (molt-cc's reading; on rhadamanth Chrome's native host keeps a claude process alive). The variable is published only once the state is where it points (AC011).
